title: Astron Competition Demo Evidence to Screen Map

evidence_levels.A: Single real-model run directly proves only the listed controlled-task facts.
evidence_levels.B: Runtime or process fault-injection evidence for listed tested windows; separate from the successful Live Proof.
evidence_levels.E: Explanatory or comparison graphic only; not empirical evidence.

visual_elements.screen_element: Scene 1 title and proof identity: ASTRON_REAL_MODEL_END_TO_END_PROOF_V1
visual_elements.public_claim: Astron completed one real-model-driven end-to-end governed task.
visual_elements.claim_level: A — LIVE_PROVEN, one controlled task only
visual_elements.allowed_wording: One controlled real-model-driven end-to-end governed task.
visual_elements.forbidden_wording: Repeated success rate; production reliability proven; universal model or tool support.

visual_elements.screen_element: Scene 1 task scope card: MAX_RPS 10 → 20; other two constants retained
visual_elements.public_claim: The controlled task made the scoped rate-limit change and preserved the other two constants.
visual_elements.allowed_wording: In the canonical task, MAX_RPS changed from 10 to 20; the other two constants were retained.
visual_elements.forbidden_wording: Astron safely edits arbitrary repositories or arbitrary system settings.

visual_elements.screen_element: Scene 1 count cards: 5 provider calls; 5 model decisions; 5 proposed/executed actions; 5 authorized; 5 journaled
visual_elements.public_claim: The canonical task recorded five calls and decisions and five actions that were proposed, authorized, executed, and journaled.
visual_elements.evidence_source: ASTRON_COMPETITION_EVIDENCE_BASELINE_V1.md §7 table and completion chain; §11 SAFE TO CLAIM; 03_TECH_REPORT_CORE.md §6; 05_VIDEO_SCRIPT.md (1:00–2:15); 07_CLAIM_LANGUAGE_AUTHORITY.md SAFE TO CLAIM.
visual_elements.allowed_wording: Five Provider calls and decisions; all five executed actions were authorized and journaled.
visual_elements.forbidden_wording: Zero denials proves the refusal path; every future action will be authorized; every adapter is bypass-proof.

visual_elements.screen_element: Evidence board metric: harness bypass observed = 0
visual_elements.public_claim: No harness bypass was observed within the saved intents, journals, receipts, application events, and captured scope for the canonical task.
visual_elements.claim_level: A — LIVE_PROVEN, limited to captured application evidence
visual_elements.allowed_wording: Harness bypass observed: 0, within the saved intents, journals, receipts, application events, and captured scope.
visual_elements.forbidden_wording: Astron can never be bypassed; no bypass exists outside the captured evidence; all adapters are bypass-proof.

visual_elements.screen_element: Scene 1 neutral responsibility comparison inset: generic tool-calling flow beside Astron's explicit authorization, action record, and verifier stages
visual_elements.public_claim: The visual describes Astron's responsibility stages relative to a generic tool-calling agent; it does not report comparative performance.
visual_elements.claim_level: E — ILLUSTRATIVE, with factual responsibility descriptions grounded in baseline; no comparative experiment
visual_elements.allowed_wording: Responsibility emphasis; no comparative experiment. The baseline does not claim other frameworks lack these mechanisms.
visual_elements.forbidden_wording: Astron is superior, safer, more reliable, or more successful than generic agents or a named framework.

visual_elements.screen_element: Scene 1 artifact card: .astron-artifacts/limiter-report.json; recorded and independently recomputed SHA-256 shown as matching
visual_elements.public_claim: The required artifact was produced and its recorded SHA-256 matched an independent recomputation.
visual_elements.allowed_wording: The artifact exists; its recorded digest matched an independently recomputed SHA-256.
visual_elements.forbidden_wording: Digest match proves the whole system or every output is correct.

visual_elements.public_claim: The saved launch configuration requested model ID deepseek-flash; returned model identity was not durably recorded.
visual_elements.claim_level: A — CONFIGURATION FACT, provider-reported identity unknown
visual_elements.allowed_wording: Requested model ID: deepseek-flash; Provider-returned model identity was not recorded.
visual_elements.forbidden_wording: The Provider confirmed it served deepseek-flash.

visual_elements.screen_element: Scene 2 positive completion timeline: PROPOSE_COMPLETE → VERIFICATION_STARTED → VERIFICATION_RESULT: ACCEPT → VERIFICATION_ACCEPTED → TASK_SUCCEEDED
visual_elements.public_claim: In the same canonical Live Proof, verifier acceptance followed the model's completion proposal and preceded task success.
visual_elements.allowed_wording: The model proposed completion; verifier acceptance came before TASK_SUCCEEDED.
visual_elements.forbidden_wording: The model's completion proposal itself made the task successful.

visual_elements.screen_element: Scene 2 acceptance criteria and durable status: AC-CeilingRaised=PASS; AC-ReportDelivered=PASS; ACCEPTED; TASK_SUCCEEDED
visual_elements.public_claim: Both declared acceptance criteria passed, durable verification was accepted, and the task reached success afterward.
visual_elements.allowed_wording: Both declared criteria passed; verification was accepted before the task succeeded.
visual_elements.forbidden_wording: Every possible task criterion or external condition is automatically verified.

visual_elements.screen_element: Scene 2 separate retained negative example: corrupt artifact → verifier refusal; labeled deterministic fault-matrix example, not a new run
visual_elements.public_claim: A retained deterministic negative example records refusal for a corrupt artifact.
visual_elements.evidence_source: ASTRON_COMPETITION_EVIDENCE_BASELINE_V1.md §§8, 13 (Evidence Index: deterministic fault matrix includes corrupt-artifact refusal); 04_DEMO_STORYBOARD.md Scene 2 guardrail; 06_JUDGE_QA.md §4.
visual_elements.claim_level: B — RETAINED DETERMINISTIC FAULT EVIDENCE; summary only, not a fresh replay
visual_elements.allowed_wording: Separate retained deterministic example: a corrupt artifact is refused by the verifier.
visual_elements.forbidden_wording: This refusal occurred in the positive Live Proof; this clip is a fresh run; raw per-process output was independently reinspected.

visual_elements.screen_element: Scene 2 memory hook: AI 说完成，不等于任务真的完成。
visual_elements.public_claim: The canonical task's completion proposal preceded verifier acceptance and task success.
visual_elements.claim_level: A — LIVE_PROVEN, tied to canonical event order
visual_elements.allowed_wording: AI 说完成，不等于任务真的完成。
visual_elements.forbidden_wording: Model statements are never useful or all agent completions are false.

visual_elements.screen_element: Scene 3 persistent qualification banner: QUALIFIED RUNTIME / FAULT-WINDOW EVIDENCE — NOT LIVE PROOF
visual_elements.public_claim: Recovery claims rely on separate retained runtime and fault-window evidence, not the positive Live Proof.
visual_elements.claim_level: B — QUALIFIED_RUNTIME_TESTED_WINDOWS; separate from A-level Live Proof
visual_elements.allowed_wording: Recovery semantics are supported for tested runtime/fault windows by retained summaries and runtime tests; not demonstrated in the successful Live Proof.
visual_elements.forbidden_wording: Recovery occurred in the successful Live Proof; recovery is proven for arbitrary systems or all failures.

visual_elements.screen_element: Scene 3 recovery state diagram: ACTION_PROPOSED → AUTHORIZED → ATTEMPT_STARTED → interruption without trusted terminal result → UNCERTAIN → trusted reconciliation; CONFIRMED_SUCCEEDED terminal/no repeat; CONFIRMED_NOT_APPLIED → RETRY_ELIGIBLE then explicit call; NO_EVIDENCE → no retry eligibility. On-screen takeaway: Timeout ≠ no side effect.
visual_elements.public_claim: For documented tested windows, recovery uses action facts and trusted reconciliation; missing evidence does not authorize retry.
visual_elements.allowed_wording: Timeout ≠ no side effect. For tested windows, an unresolved attempt becomes UNCERTAIN and requires trusted reconciliation; NO_EVIDENCE gives no retry eligibility. Only trusted confirmation of non-application can allow retry eligibility, followed by an explicit call.
visual_elements.forbidden_wording: Exactly-once is guaranteed for arbitrary external systems; a missing response proves the action did not happen; retry is automatic.

visual_elements.public_claim: The baseline records a retained deterministic fault-matrix summary of 15/15 for its tested cases.
visual_elements.claim_level: B — RETAINED SUMMARY, original per-process outputs unavailable for line-by-line review
visual_elements.allowed_wording: Retained deterministic fault-matrix summary: 15/15 for the tested matrix.
visual_elements.forbidden_wording: Freshly rerun; current-commit regression receipt; statistically proven reliability; raw outputs independently reverified.
